critic.fix_suggestion: Add 4 thin box geometries to the fuselage cylinder to represent door frames. Position them at X-coordinates -150, -50, 50, and 150 relative to the center axis; set their height to 60% of the fuselage diameter and width to 20% of the diameter. Additionally, place 8 thin plane geometries as horizontal panel lines across the fuselage at 25% intervals along the Y-axis to break up the smooth surface.
